承認後、`openfisca-japan:dashboard/package.json` に次の差分を反映する。
```diff
@@ scripts
-    "cy:open": "./node_modules/.bin/cypress open",
-    "cy:run": "./node_modules/.bin/cypress run",
+    "test:e2e": "playwright test",
@@ dependencies
-    "axe-core": "^4.7.2",
-    "cypress-axe": "^1.4.0",
@@ devDependencies
-    "cypress": "^12.17.4",
```
導入済みの `@playwright/test` は維持する。ホスト側で `dashboard` の `npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts` により lockfile を同期し、`npm ci` の成功を確認する。

承認後、`openfisca-japan:.github/workflows/test_frontend.yml` に次の差分を反映する。
```diff
-      - name: Cypress run
-        uses: cypress-io/github-action@v6
-        with:
-          build: npm run build
-          start: npm run preview
-          working-directory: ./dashboard
+      - name: Install Playwright Chromium
+        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+        working-directory: ./dashboard
+      - name: Build
+        run: npm run build
+        working-directory: ./dashboard
+      - name: Playwright smoke
+        run: npm run test:e2e
+        working-directory: ./dashboard
```

runner は sandbox 外で `node tools/specdojo-pre-commit.mjs register-build` と親検証を実行する。sandbox では register-build が `spawnSync git EPERM` で実行できなかった。
